t_advice_summary_textbox.text: focus on the colours as they give you moremushrooms, especially in the x5 rounds. Sometimes the colours switch to the opposite way to be careful to watch the pattern of this happening.

vb_textbox.text: Focus on the coloured gnomes that earn more mushrooms and pick these most of the time, these get a lot more points in the x5 rounds. Sometimes in the round the patter of this will switch, so what would have given you a higher number of mushrooms now gives you a lower amount. Take notice of this and pick the opposite to what you would have chosen before. When you notice your choices give lower mushrooms again, switch back to your original colour tactic. Sometimes this can happen multiple times in each round so pay attention.
